mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile because the continuous loop made the two journeys easier to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left-side valves repeated the right-side sequence, so it felt predictable even though their jobs were clear.

surprise.text: The heart muscle needs its own blood vessels; blood inside the chambers cannot supply all of its thick muscle.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The valve positions and vessel routes had clear purposes, though several later choices were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: connecting the two routes and learning that the heart needs its own supply made me curious about how other body systems fit together, despite the repetitive valve fittings.
